name: A4 塑性纸张 · 压折实验原型
description: 210×297 mm；折叠、压折、松手保留折痕；紧密揉团尚未通过验证
upstream_origin: kami MIT solver + FQ rectangular adaptation
license_status: MIT upstream solver; see tools/a4_paper/LICENSE-kami.txt and provenance.json
viewer_status: 边缘夹持折叠、压折、释放后的折痕保留
实验中：紧密挤压出现过大局部变形与面片穿插，未通过
NVIDIA Warp / kami；矩形适配，未实物标定
MuJoCo / USD 为静态网格；USD 动画为烘焙回放
limitations: Tight crumpling is NOT validated; compression trials show excessive edge strain and triangle intersections
Uncalibrated rectangular adaptation of a square-grid solver; isotropy and force accuracy are not validated
Kinematic edge clamps and prescribed tools, not friction-only robot grasp
Numerical layer spacing 0.6 mm is larger than the assumed 0.1 mm physical thickness
Discrete vertex-triangle self contact, no continuous-collision guarantee; intersection check excludes coplanar contacts
No tearing, paper fiber anisotropy, moisture dependence, robotic or airport integration
MuJoCo preview contains no dynamic paper physics or collision proxy; USD playback is baked geometry
